issue_request: Published/Persuasive BRR change request for the R4 MedicinalProductPackaged artifact asking that short definitions and long definitions not be identical, because long definitions should provide more robust detail. The accepted resolution was to provide distinct wording.

The Jira comment from February 1, 2022 says the change was applied across all resources.
additional_context: The current build uses PackagedProductDefinition as the active successor for the MedicinalProductPackaged tracker area: source/fhir.ini lists PackagedProductDefinition as an active draft resource and keeps an R4 conversion alias for MedicinalProductPackaged. Current source has evolved after the R5 application, but a fresh scan of active StructureDefinition XML files found no exact or punctuation-only duplicate short/definition pairs, including no duplicates in the BRR medicinal product resources.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was necessary because the current source already satisfies the issue request.
